200.description: A stable page of incidents ordered by most recent update.

409.description: The incident identity was already used for different alert content.

200.description: The persisted incident and exact packet when complete.
The integrity-checked evidence, invocation, packet, and trace replay.

200.description: The incident view and integrity-checked replay when available.
The current recovery workflow, immutable verification evidence, closure, and audit history.

409.description: The persisted recovery aggregate failed integrity verification.

200.description: The exact verified recovery was closed by an authorized human.

503.description: No authoritative simulator currentness fence is configured for closure.

200.description: The current immutable plan, decision, and verified audit history.
